name: GET /api/offers/:offer_id - Fetch one offer
description: Fetches a single offer by id and returns 200 with data.offer. tenant_id is a REQUIRED QUERY PARAMETER, not a claim: getOffer scopes by (tenant_id, offer_id), so omitting it is 400 rather than defaulting to the caller's tenant. That also means the 404 is tenant-scoped - an offer_id that exists under a different tenant answers 404 NotFound, not 403, so this route never confirms the existence of another tenant's offer. Returns the offer envelope only; it does not include versions or the current live version - use GET /api/offers/:offer_id/versions and GET /api/offers/:offer_id/current for those.

errorCases.name: Unauthenticated
errorCases.when: No Authorization: Bearer header - requireAuth preHandler, and the gateway default-deny authGate ahead of it
The tenant_id query parameter is absent - this route reads the tenant from the query, never from the JWT claim
No offer matches (tenant_id, offer_id) - including an offer that exists under a DIFFERENT tenant, which answers 404 rather than 403 so the route never confirms another tenant's data

errorCases.message: Fastify default error payload from the uncaught service throw
errorCases.when: getOffer throws - a non-UUID offer_id that fails the Postgres uuid cast, or any database error
